basic_details.job_title: IISER Thiruvananthapuram Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER) Thiruvananthapuram is hiring one Junior Research Fellow (JRF), on contract, for the externally funded ANRF project "Diophantine approximation with prime restriction". The tenure is 1 year, extendable to two or more depending on the candidate's performance. The fellowship is Rs. 37000 + HRA for the first 2 years and 42000 + HRA for the third year, and candidates must be below 25 years of age. The minimum qualification, experience and application method are given in the advertisement document linked from the notice. The last date is

how_to_apply: The notice does not describe the application steps on its own page. It says that the way to apply is given in the advertisement document at https://www.iisertvm.ac.in/files/read/opening-jrf-dr-jyothsna-2026-10-16. Applications must be made by 30 November 2026.
